productionMeaning.request: callEmergency L17411–17425 starts the smartphone request and consumes a use. That request already has an action-smartphone variant and does not ring this bell.
productionMeaning.start: resolveSmartphoneAction L17428–17439 checks the deadline and player/room state, then calls startMeeting. L10577–10592 changes the phase and assigns a new meeting.id.
productionMeaning.input: Only an explicit emergencyMeetingStarted receipt in meeting phase with a fresh meetingId. Repeated IDs are ignored for this preview session. No branch infers emergency origin from reason text, time, a state snapshot alone or private evidence. A real typed producer/consumer remains unconnected.
productionMeaning.scope: Shared meeting interface, using a synthetic anonymous notification. No vote, body-report, caller identity, suspect, evidence, location, tallies, weapons or gameplay state is depicted.

design.concept: A hanging brass bell produces one strike when the meeting actually convenes. The clapper approaches the left inner rim, the rim catches a warm highlight, and the body rocks back to its quiet orientation.
design.dimensions: Procedural UI icon. Nominal lip is approximately 68 CSS px wide at scale 1; adapt downward to fit, with DPR handled in backing coordinates. Idle and post-event show the same neutral bell and bearing.
design.phases: 0–195 ms clapper approaches; 195 ms contact initiates ring and local light; a single reflected highlight follows the mouth for 440 ms after contact. Damped displacement and resonance decay to neutral before expiry.
design.material: Warm cast surface with broad curved specular response, dark opening, fixed upper mount and a moving clapper. A short local optical bloom is modulated by the same contact energy. The UI bell is a metaphor; no physical bell at a map position is implied.
design.audio: Four damped, inharmonic modes enter only after 195 ms contact; no repeated alarm. Ordinary audio starts at the current elapsed offset after current GPU completion. Verify always muted; stop, replacement and hide cancel sound.
design.reducedMotion: Damp body tilt to 27 percent, preserve the contact geometry, causal order and finite light.
design.technicalReuse: WebGPU lifecycle, display diagnostics, audio admission and UI wiring adapted from public meeting-vote-receipt R1. New creative shapes, motion, meeting gate and synthesis. No new raster texture.

basis.applied: Finite causal time, material shading, registered pivot/contact, local emission and optical response, procedural WebGPU and synchronized SFX.

validation.sourceReadback: 4 of 4 UTF-8 texts equal at runtime commit. File hashes in files.
validation.nodeSyntax: preview module passed node --check. Announcement module executed in Node.
validation.gate: Missing/empty/bad IDs, pending smartphone request, body report and wrong phase rejected; distinct meetings admitted once; repeats even after other meetings rejected; reason/suspect getters never accessed.
validation.audio: 8000,44100,48000,96000 Hz finite PCM, strict pre-contact silence, nonzero attack, decaying tail, peak below 0.5 and zero endpoint. Numeric only.
validation.contact: Reference geometry: steady clapper clears the left rim, clapper disk reaches the localized strike position at 195 ms. This is not a pixel observation.
